messages:
noah (Finance): FYI FairRoute (acct FR-88) got INV-2026-0910 with $3,240 in burst/overage. They want a line-by-line breakdown and a credit. Export: https://billing.internal/redwood/exports/INV-2026-0910.csv
lina (AcctExec): How does that compare to their reserved commit? token vs hour billing?
ops-bot: Export ready: INV-2026-0910 | reserved_commit: $15,000 | burst_charges: $3,240 | burst_window: 2026-03-11T18:20Z to 2026-03-12T02:10Z | meter_file: s3://billing/exports/1934567890_INV-2026-0910.csv
marta (CS): FairRoute reports elevated latency in eu-west-2 ~03/11 18:15Z, auto-redirected to us-east-2; their app logs show longer responses and higher token counts. Sending their traces; cc'ing praveen.
praveen (EngOps): Quick infra summary: maintenance in eu-west-2 triggered regional steering; ~22% of requests went to us-east-2. Routing + model-fallback chosen (compat variant) caused KV cache cold starts and repeated prefix retransmissions. Meter snippet below (sanitized):
```
line,region,model,committed_hours,burst_hours,tokens_extra,cost
1,us-east-2,redwood-3b-q,12,3,90000,360
2,us-east-2,redwood-13b-compat,4,9,420000,1680
3,eu-west-2,redwood-7b,20,1,0,0
4,us-east-2,instance-surge,0,2,0,1200
```
praveen (EngOps): Token unit price used here is $0.004/token for extra tokens. Line 2 token excess explains $1,680; line 1 is $360; line 4 is surge instance charge $1,200. Totals to $3,240. Root cause: routing policy + fallback to heavier compat model during maintenance.
noah (Finance): Given this looks platform-triggered (steering + fallback) I propose a one-off remediation: waive 60% of burst charges for that window (60% of $3,240 = $1,944) and additionally grant a $300 SLA goodwill credit for the latency window. This keeps some customer responsibility but acknowledges platform impact. Thoughts?
hannah (Revenue): Agree with a one-off credit but want guardrails. Approve if we: (1) attach formal incident write-up, (2) open engineering ticket to disable fallback to heavier variant by default during steer, and (3) limit to a single credit for this invoice.
lina (AcctExec): I can communicate that. Approve credit amount and SLA credit contingent on praveen linking the mitigation ticket and an incident summary for the customer note.
praveen (EngOps): I'll open ENG-1427 to prevent compat fallback for regional redirects and add a dashboard alert for KV-miss spikes. Will post the incident summary here when ready.
billing-queue-bot: Credit queued -> SUBJECT: INV-2026-0910 | CREDIT_BURST: $1944 | CREDIT_SLA: $300 | ACTION: pending billing-head manual review | Ticket: BILL-7905
noah (Finance): Thanks everyone. Lina, can you flag when the customer accepts the proposed remediation? I'll schedule ledger reversal after billing-head signs off and mark the dispute in our tracker. Closing thread unless we need more detail. :white_check_mark:
